description: Land adjacency on the Sentinel-3 OLCI 300 m lattice. rows_rle (ring 1): cells that carried a chlorophyll value in at least one of the scenes listed and touch (8 neighbours) a cell that carried none and lies within 4 cells of the OpenStreetMap shoreline. rows_rle_ring2 (ring 2): cells with a value that touch ring 1. The satellite chlorophyll layers leave out the rings their product is set to (sources/satellite.py Product.land_adjacent_rings): there one pixel holds land and water together, or sits in the land's stray light. Built by pipeline/scripts/build_land_adjacency_mask.py; evidence in docs/coastwatch/v13/research/coastal-adjacency.md.
source: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP https://coastwatch.noaa.gov/erddap: noaacwS3AOLCIchlaSectorCIDaily, noaacwS3AOLCIchlaSectorDIDaily, noaacwS3BOLCIchlaSectorCIDaily, noaacwS3BOLCIchlaSectorDIDaily
